newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine overnight interest rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Philippine overnight interest rates unchanged.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday it decided to keep its overnight borrowing and lending rates unchanged at 20 percent and 22 respectively.
There had been widespread speculation of an imminent rate cut, especially after the U.S. left rates alone.
"The Central Bank thinks it may be too soon. It wants to make sure there would be no more attacks on the peso," a foreign bank dealer said.
The Central Bank last Thursday and Friday raised its overnight borrowing by a total of 8.75 percentage points to protect the peso from speculation arising from the crisis in the Thai baht.
